metadata.question: Does the northern Pacific Ocean at an eastern location (48.504441, -137.527803) exhibit a higher sea surface temperature anomaly during January 1-31, 2016, compared to a western location (46.750838, -169.318365)? The anomaly is calculated against the baseline average from 2003 to 2012.

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use NOAA's SST dataset (NOAA/CDR/SSTWHOI/V2 or similar SST product) - Need data for January 2016 (comparison period) and 2003-2012 (baseline) - Two point locations in the Pacific Ocean 2. Masking strategy: - SST data typically has quality flags or masking for land/ice - Should apply quality masking if available - No cloud masking needed for ocean temperature data 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - SST anomaly can legitimately be negative, zero, or positive - Need to check if data exists for both locations - Verify pixel counts > 0 after any masking - Check that computed values are within reasonable range (e.g., -10 to +10°C for anomaly) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const eastLoc = ee.Geometry.Point([-137.527803, 48.504441]); const westLoc = ee.Geometry.Point([-169.318365, 46.750838]); const baseline_start = '2003-01-01'; const baseline_end = '2012-12-31'; const target_start = '2016-01-01'; const target_end = '2016-01-31'; // 2. Data Acquisition const sstCollection = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/CDR/SSTWHOI/V2') .select('sea_surface_temperature'); // Get baseline average (2003-2012) const baselineCol = sstCollection .filterDate(baseline_start, baseline_end) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(1, 1, 'month')); // January only const baselineSize = baselineCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Baseline images (Jan 2003-2012): ${baselineSize}`); if (baselineSize === 0) { console.log('No baseline data found.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Get January 2016 data const targetCol = sstCollection .filterDate(target_start, target_end); const targetSize = targetCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Target images (Jan 2016): ${targetSize}`); if (targetSize === 0) { console.log('No data for January 2016.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Calculate baseline means const baselineMean = baselineCol.mean(); const targetMean = targetCol.mean(); // 4. Calculate anomalies const anomaly = targetMean.subtract(baselineMean); // 5. Extract values at both locations const scale = 5000; // Eastern location const eastAnomaly = anomaly.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: eastLoc, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('sea_surface_temperature'); const eastCount = anomaly.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: eastLoc, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('sea_surface_temperature'); // Western location const westAnomaly = anomaly.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: westLoc, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('sea_surface_temperature'); const westCount = anomaly.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: westLoc, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('sea_surface_temperature'); // Get values const eastVal = eastAnomaly.getInfo(); const westVal = westAnomaly.getInfo(); const eastPixels = eastCount.getInfo(); const westPixels = westCount.getInfo(); console.log(`East location (${eastLoc.coordinates().getInfo()}): Anomaly=${eastVal}, Pixels=${eastPixels}`); console.log(`West location (${westLoc.coordinates().getInfo()}): Anomaly=${westVal}, Pixels=${westPixels}`); // 6. Validation & Final Answer if (eastPixels === 0 || westPixels === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels at one or both locations.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (eastVal === null || westVal === null || isNaN(eastVal) || isNaN(westVal)) { console.log('Calculation failed - null or NaN result.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Check reasonable range for SST anomaly (-10 to +10°C) if (Math.abs(eastVal) > 10 || Math.abs(westVal) > 10) { console.log('Anomaly values outside reasonable range.'); console.log('C3'); return; } console.log(`\nComparison: East anomaly (${eastVal.toFixed(3)}°C) vs West anomaly (${westVal.toFixed(3)}°C)`); if (eastVal > westVal) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
